features.label: Features
features.heading: Built for translators, powered by AI
features.description: Everything you need to go from raw scans to publication-ready releases.
features.aiTranslationDesc: One-click OCR and translation with GPT, Gemini, or Claude. Supports 50+ languages with context-aware accuracy.
features.smartCleaningDesc: AI inpainting removes text while preserving original artwork. Clean speech bubbles and SFX in seconds.
features.proTypesettingDesc: Precise text placement with full font control, sizing, and alignment. Professional results right in the browser.
features.batchProcessingDesc: Import up to 80 pages at once. Process entire chapters with consistent settings and quality.
features.openSourceDesc: 100% open source and free. Self-host or use in-browser. No vendor lock-in, your data stays yours.
features.builtForTeamsDesc: Designed for localization and scanlation teams. Streamlined workflow from raw to release, built by the community.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.heading: Five steps to perfection
workflow.description: A streamlined pipeline from raw scans to publication-ready pages.
workflow.importDesc: Drag and drop your manga pages into the editor. Supports PNG, JPG, and WebP — up to 80 pages in a single batch.
workflow.detectDesc: AI-powered OCR scans every panel, identifying text in speech bubbles, captions, and sound effects with precise bounding boxes.
workflow.cleanDesc: Neural inpainting intelligently removes original text while reconstructing the artwork underneath — preserving line art and textures.
workflow.translateDesc: Context-aware AI translates between 50+ languages. It understands manga conventions, character speech patterns, and cultural nuance.
workflow.typesetExportDesc: Place translated text with pixel-perfect precision. Control fonts, sizes, rotation — then export publication-ready pages.

community.heading: Built by translators, for translators
community.description: KomaKun! is born from the localization community. We understand the grind of OCR, cleaning, and typesetting — because we've been there. This is our gift to every translation team worldwide.

cta.heading: Ready to translate?
